First, we note the following:

$$
C:\,{{{x}_{1}^{2}-8{x}_{1}{x}_{2}-5{x}_{2}^{2}}_{⏟}}_{Q(x)}-12\sqrt{5}{x}_{1}+6\sqrt{5}{x}_{2}+12=0
$$

Let's write the given change of variables explicitly:

$$
[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2}\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}-\frac{2}{\sqrt{5}} & \frac{1}{\sqrt{5}} \\ \frac{1}{\sqrt{5}} & \frac{2}{\sqrt{5}}\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}{y}_{1} \\ {y}_{2}\end{aligned}]\,⟹\,{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}=-\frac{2}{\sqrt{5}}{y}_{1}+\frac{1}{\sqrt{5}}{y}_{2} \\ {x}_{2}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{5}}{y}_{1}+\frac{2}{\sqrt{5}}{y}_{2},\end{aligned}
$$

We know that the given change of variables reduces $Q(x)$ to its canonical form. Therefore, performing the change of variables on $C,$ we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}^{2}-8{x}_{1}{x}_{2}-5{x}_{2}^{2}-12\sqrt{5}{x}_{1}+6\sqrt{5}{x}_{2}+12 & =0 \\ 3{y}_{1}^{2}-7{y}_{2}^{2}-12\sqrt{5}(-\frac{2}{\sqrt{5}}{y}_{1}+\frac{1}{\sqrt{5}}{y}_{2})+6\sqrt{5}(\frac{1}{\sqrt{5}}{y}_{1}+\frac{2}{\sqrt{5}}{y}_{2})+12 & =0 \\ 3{y}_{1}^{2}-7{y}_{2}^{2}+30{y}_{1}+12 & =0\end{aligned}
$$

 

Now, we complete the square for the variable ${y}_{1}:$

$$
\begin{aligned}3{y}_{1}^{2}-7{y}_{2}^{2}+30{y}_{1}+12 & =0 \\ 3({y}_{1}^{2}+10{y}_{1})-7{y}_{2}^{2}+12 & =0 \\ 3({y}_{1}^{2}+10{y}_{1}+25-25)-7{y}_{2}^{2}+12 & =0 \\ 3({y}_{1}^{2}+10{y}_{1}+25)-75-7{y}_{2}^{2}+12 & =0 \\ 3({y}_{1}+5)^{2}-7{y}_{2}^{2}-63 & =0 \\ 3({y}_{1}+5)^{2}-7{y}_{2}^{2} & =63\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, performing the change of variables

$$
{\begin{aligned}{z}_{1}={y}_{1}+5, \\ {z}_{2}={y}_{2},\end{aligned}
$$

we get the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}3{z}_{1}^{2}-7{z}_{2}^{2} & =63 \\ \frac{{z}_{1}^{2}}{21}-\frac{{z}_{2}^{2}}{9} & =1 \\ \frac{{z}_{1}^{2}}{(\sqrt{21})^{2}}-\frac{{z}_{2}^{2}}{{3}^{2}} & =1\end{aligned}
$$

 

This represents a hyperbola with semiaxes  $\sqrt{21}$ and $3.$
